actions.name: conducted a multi-faceted campaign to interfere in the 2020 US presidential election
actions.description: Starting in August 2020, Emennet Pasargad actors conducted a multi-faceted campaign to interfere in the 2020 US presidential election.

actions.name: obtained confidential U.S. voter information from at least one state election website

actions.name: sent threatening email messages to intimidate voters
actions.description: As part of this campaign, the actors sent threatening email messages to intimidate voters.

actions.name: created and disseminated a video containing disinformation pertaining to purported but non-existent voting vulnerabilities
actions.description: As part of this campaign, the actors created and disseminated a video containing disinformation pertaining to purported but non-existent voting vulnerabilities.

actions.name: attempted to access, without authorization, several states’ voting-related websites
actions.description: The actors attempted to access, without authorization, several states’ voting-related websites.

actions.name: successfully gained unauthorized access to a U.S. media company’s computer network
actions.description: The actors successfully gained unauthorized access to a U.S. media company’s computer network.

actions.name: masqueraded as members of the Proud Boys in the voter intimidation and disinformation aspects of the campaign
actions.description: During the 2020 election interference campaign, the actors claimed affiliation with the Proud Boys in the voter intimidation and disinformation aspects of the campaign.

actions.name: masqueraded as the "Yemen Cyber Army" and crafted messaging critical of Saudi Arabia in late 2018
actions.description: In late 2018, the group masqueraded as the "Yemen Cyber Army" and crafted messaging critical of Saudi Arabia.

actions.name: demonstrated interest in leveraging bulk SMS services likely to mass-disseminate propaganda or other messaging

actions.name: conducted traditional cyber exploitation activity targeting several sectors including news, shipping, travel, oil and petrochemical, financial, and telecommunications

actions.name: used Virtual Private Network (VPN) services to obfuscate the origin of their activity
actions.description: Emennet is known to use Virtual Private Network (VPN) services to obfuscate the origin of their activity, likely including TorGuard, CyberGhost, NordVPN, and Private Internet Access.

actions.name: performed reconnaissance and chose potential victims by performing web searches for leading businesses in various sectors
actions.description: Over the past three years, Emennet conducted reconnaissance and chose potential victims by performing web searches for leading businesses in various sectors such as “top American news sites.”

actions.name: scanned websites for vulnerable software that could be exploited to establish persistent access
actions.description: Emennet used web search results to scan websites for vulnerable software that could be exploited to establish persistent access.

actions.name: researched how to exploit specific software including identifying open source available tools
actions.description: After the initial reconnaissance phase, Emennet typically researched how to exploit specific software, including identifying open source available tools.

actions.name: demonstrated interest in identifying webpages running PHP code and externally accessible mysql databases (phpMyAdmin)
actions.description: Emennet demonstrated interest in identifying webpages running PHP code and identifying externally accessible mysql databases (in particular, phpMyAdmin).

actions.name: demonstrated interest in exploiting Wordpress (revslider and layerslider plugins), Drupal, Apache Tomcat, Ckeditor and Fckeditor (including Roxy Fileman)

actions.name: attempted to identify default passwords and admin/login pages for targeted applications
actions.description: When conducting research, Emennet attempted to identify default passwords for particular applications a target may be using, and tried to identify admin and/or login pages associated with those same targeted websites.

actions.name: attempted common plaintext passwords for any login sites identified
actions.description: It should be assumed Emennet may attempt common plaintext passwords for any login sites they identify.

actions.name: used the open source penetration testing tool SQLmap during operational activity
actions.description: Emennet is known to use the open source penetration testing tool SQLmap during operational activity.

actions.name: used the commercially available tool Acunetix during operational activity
actions.description: Emennet is known to use the commercially available tool Acunetix during operational activity.
